prompt.text:
Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of DEPTH MINE. Redraw the referenced subject as the sheet described below. Keep the exact design, silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials, top-left lighting, outline weight and rendering style of the reference in every cell; only the pose or state changes from cell to cell, and the layout follows the grid described: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shooter, a regular grid of six equal cells in two rows of three with even gutters, read left to right and top to bottom, every cell showing the same DEPTH MINE enemy — a rounded black hull studded with short contact spikes, a single cyan eye-light at its center and a short gunmetal anchor chain hanging below, side view facing left, at the same scale and position, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. The frames in order: eye dark, eye dim, eye bright, eye dim, chain severed and drifting free, exploded into a ring of loose spikes with a fading cyan glow. Follow the established design exactly; only the pose or state changes between cells. Crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, identical silhouette and palette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 Keep the reference's teal glass cap on the upper left of the hull in every cell. Cells one to four are the whole mine with its chain and weight, the eye dark, dim, bright, dim; cell five is the whole mine with only a short broken chain stub, drifting free; cell six is the burst ring of loose spikes. No anchors. Only green space between the cells, no lines.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, watermark, blurry, green tint on the subject, green spill
